fixture_fingerprint.note: Release PCK contains imported scripts. Constant is verified against canonical fixture by prebuild tests; actual actor/combat/haul/construction checks and binary hashes provide runtime evidence.

method.fixture: Canonical deterministic 32 friendly / 100 enemy fixture, connected salvage hauling, powered production, three paid building orders and one paid road order. Increased HP retains workload; no balanced-combat claim.
method.frame_scope: Wall intervals between RenderingServer.frame_post_draw signals from the actual native app, including real main simulation loop, world/HUD drawing, diagnostics observations and rendering/presentation pacing. Not physical scanout timing.
method.limits: Local host; OS and other processes uncontrolled. Each zoom starts the same fixture, then actual 20 Hz simulation advances by wall time, so faster rendering covers less simulated time for a fixed frame count. Quick/prepare checks do not establish performance. No cursor warp or desktop display-mode change.
method.percentiles: Nearest rank over individual frames/ticks. FPS = measured frames / sum of measured wall intervals.
method.render_scope: RenderingServer viewport CPU/GPU and frame setup CPU milliseconds where supported; excludes game scripts. Performance monitors are sampled engine totals and cannot be added to isolated subsystem timers.
method.save_scope: After measured frame 300, actual app.save_campaign(false) runs on the main thread. Its wall pause is included in frame interval 301. Save call and read/semantic verification times are recorded separately; verification also remains included in that wall interval.
method.screenshots: Captured after measurement; GPU readback/PNG encoding and RSS/binary hashing are outside sampled frame intervals.
method.simulation_scope: Actual main._process accumulator calls timed campaign_simulation.tick(0.05) at 20 Hz. Tick timer wraps only super.tick; workload observation follows and remains included in wall frames.
